messages:
Nina R.: Quick heads-up: running a short access sanity sweep tomorrow AM. focus: ownerless admin bindings, cross-account KMS grants, and noisy decrypters.
Carlos T.: scope? prod + shared infra?
Nina R.: yes. prod + shared infra, plus random sample of 75 services. want to catch svcaccts with broad kms:Decrypt.
Ava K.: I'll reuse the ownerless detector. simple rule: `role_bindings WHERE owner IS NULL OR owner = '' AND last_active > 30d`. posts CSV.
Carlos T.: Add KMS activity correlate: count distinct regions per principal for kms:Decrypt over 90d. flag >2 regions.
Ava K.: SQL snippet: `SELECT principal, COUNT(DISTINCT region) regions FROM kms_audit WHERE action='kms:Decrypt' AND time > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY principal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT region) > 2;`
Nina R.: Good. Also join to `entitlement_current` to show current_role, grant_source, grant_ttl. filter TTL < 1d to reduce SSO noise.
security-bot: Reminder: entitlement-sweep scheduled by nina.r at 2024-07-10T09:00Z.
Carlos T.: Remediation approach proposal: 1) owners-first notify 48h 2) annotate binding with `sweep:pending` tag 3) soft-block by removing kms:Decrypt from broad roles 4) escalate+rotate key only if active misuse.
Ava K.: For cross-account detection: compare key account_id vs binding account. quick grep pattern: `key_arn NOT LIKE '%:account_id:%'`.
remediation-bot: Playbook snippet: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding KEY --member='serviceAccount:...' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter'` (preferred) vs key delete.
Nina R.: Action owners: Ava runs detection 09:00 PT and posts CSV, Carlos drafts remediation doc and CLI snippets, I'll handle owner outreach. 12:30 PT quick sync.
Carlos T.: Final ask: capture top-10 highest-risk principals and push owner notifications before any auto-revoke.
Nina R.: Agreed. owners-first, automated steps only after 48h and infra-sec signoff.
